b) / s\n\ndef plabel(n, ops):\n    s = [\"I\"] * n\n    for q, l in ops.items():\n        s[n - 1 - q] = l\n    return \"\".join(s)\n\ndef maxcut_H(n):\n    t = [(\"I\" * n, 0.5 * (n - 1))]\n    t += [(plabel(n, {i: \"Z\", i + 1: \"Z\"}), -0.5) for i in range(n - 1)]\n    return SparsePauliOp.from_list(t)\n\ndef hard_H(n, seed):\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    t = []\n    for L in \"XYZ\":\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            t.append((plabel(n, {i: L, i + 1: L}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.55))))\n        for i in range(n):\n            t.append((plabel(n, {i: L}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.4))))\n    return SparsePauliOp.from_list(t).simplify()\n\ndef idle_fn(qc):\n    qc.barrier()\n    for q in range(qc.num_qubits):\n        qc.delay(IDLE_US, q, unit=\"us\")\n    qc.barrier()\n\ndef qaoa_prep(n, p, gammas, betas, with_idle=True):\n    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)\n    qc.h(range(n))\n    for layer in range(p):\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n            qc.rz(-2 * gammas[layer], i + 1)\n            qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n        if with_idle:\n            idle_fn(qc)\n        qc.rx(2 * betas[layer], range(n))\n        if with_idle:\n            idle_fn(qc)\n    return qc\n\ndef hea_prep(n, layers, params, with_idle=True):\n    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)\n    for L in range(layers):\n        for q in range(n):\n            qc.ry(float(params[L, q, 0]), q)\n            qc.rz(float(params[L, q, 1]), q)\n            qc.rx(float(params[L, q, 2]), q)\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n        for i in range(n - 2, -1, -1):\n            qc.cx(i + 1, i)\n        if with_idle:\n            idle_fn(qc)\n    return qc\n\ndef h_ideal(prep, H):\n    return float(np.real(Statevector.from_instruction(prep).expectation_value(H)))\n\ndef spectrum_span(H):\n    ev = np.linalg.eigvalsh(H.to_matrix())\n    return float(ev[-1] - ev[0])\n\ndef z_groups(H):\n    terms = list(zip(H.paulis.to_labels(), np.real(H.coeffs)))\n    buckets = {\"X\": [], \"Y\": [], \"Z\": [], \"I\": []}\n    for lab, w in terms:\n        letters = set(lab) - {\"I\"}\n        if not letters:\n            buckets[\"I\"].append((lab, w))\n        elif letters <= {\"Z\"}:\n            buckets[\"Z\"].append((lab, w))\n        elif letters <= {\"X\"}:\n            buckets[\"X\"].append((lab, w))\n        elif letters <= {\"Y\"}:\n            buckets[\"Y\"].append((lab, w))\n        else:\n            buckets[\"Z\"].append((lab, w))\n    groups = []\n    for basis in (\"X\", \"Y\", \"Z\"):\n        items = buckets[basis] + (buckets[\"I\"] if basis == \"Z\" else [])\n        if not items and basis != \"Z\":\n            continue\n        if not items:\n            items = buckets[\"I\"] or [(\"I\" * N, 0.0)]\n        groups.append(dict(basis=basis, op=SparsePauliOp.from_list(items)))\n    return groups or [dict(basis=\"Z\", op=H)]\n\ndef group_stats(counts, op, n):\n    labels = op.paulis.to_labels()\n    coeffs = np.real(op.coeffs)\n    vals, cnt = [], []\n    for bs, c in counts.items():\n        s = bs.replace(\" \", \"\")[-n:].zfill(n)\n        e = 0.0\n        for lab, w in zip(labels, coeffs):\n            par = 0\n            for i, ch in enumerate(lab):\n                if ch != \"I\" and s[i] == \"1\":\n                    par ^= 1\n            e += w * (1 - 2 * par)\n        vals.append(e); cnt.append(c)\n    cnt = np.asarray(cnt, float)\n    shots = max(cnt.sum(), 1.0)\n    return np.asarray(vals), cnt / shots, int(shots)\n\ndef estimate_energy(gcounts, gops, n):\n    h, var = 0.0, 0.0\n    for counts, op in zip(gcounts, gops):\n        v, p, shots = group_stats(counts, op, n)\n        m = float(p @ v)\n        h += m\n        var += float(p @ (v ** 2) - m ** 2) / max(shots, 1)\n    return h, math.sqrt(max(var, 0.0))\n\nH1 = maxcut_H(N)\nbest, GAMMAS, BETAS = None, None, None\nfor _ in range(20):\n    g = RNG.uniform(0.2, 1.0, size=QAOA_P)\n    b = RNG.uniform(0.1, 0.5, size=QAOA_P)\n    e = h_ideal(qaoa_prep(N, QAOA_P, g, b, with_idle=False), H1)\n    if best is None or e > best:\n        best, GAMMAS, BETAS = e, g.copy(), b.copy()\nspan1 = spectrum_span(H1)\nhid1 = h_ideal(qaoa_prep(N, QAOA_P, GAMMAS, BETAS, with_idle=False), H1)\n\nT5_H, T5_P, t5b = None, None, -1.0\nfor s in range(80):\n    H = hard_H(N, s)\n    sp = spectrum_span(H)\n    if sp < 1e-6: continue\n    params = RNG.uniform(0, 2 * np.pi, size=(HEA_LAYERS, N, 3))\n    hid = h_ideal(hea_prep(N, HEA_LAYERS, params, with_idle=False), H)\n    cond = abs(hid) / sp\n    if cond > t5b:\n        t5b, T5_H, T5_P = cond, H, params.copy()\nspan5 = spectrum_span(T5_H)\nhid5 = h_ideal(hea_prep(N, HEA_LAYERS, T5_P, with_idle=False), T5_H)\n\nHAM = {\n    \"T1_QAOA\": dict(H=H1, h_id=hid1, span=span1, groups=z_groups(H1), kind=\"qaoa\"),\n    \"T5_HEA\":  dict(H=T5_H, h_id=hid5, span=span5, groups=z_groups(T5_H), kind=\"hea\"),\n}\nprint(\"T1 hid=%.3f span=%.3f | T5 hid=%.3f span=%.3f\" % (hid1, span1, hid5, span5))\nprint(\"2q gates approx T1=%d T5=%d | idle=%.0f us × capas\" % (\n    QAOA_P * (N - Dispositivo hostil + EQG\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"bbae1bbd-5f11-4927-a451-2dca67eb0fec","cell_type":"code","source":"class HostileDevice:\n    \"\"\"Ruido agresivo: qubits malos con T1 corto, RO/X/CX altos.\"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, cfg, seed=SEED):\n        self.cfg = cfg\n        self.M = cfg[\"M\"]\n        self.rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n        # malos al FINAL del chip → baseline [0..N-1] cae en zona buena;\n        # forzamos malos EN EL INICIO para que layout ingenuo sufra\n        self.bad = set(range(cfg[\"n_bad\"]))  # 0..n_bad-1 muy malos\n        self.live = self._state()\n\n    def _state(self):\n        st = {}\n        for q in range(self.M):\n            bad = q in self.bad\n            st[q] = dict(\n                ro=self.cfg[\"ro_bad\"] if bad else self.cfg[\"ro_good\"],\n                xerr=self.cfg[\"x_bad\"] if bad else self.cfg[\"x_good\"],\n                t1=self.cfg[\"t1_bad_us\"] if bad else self.cfg[\"t1_good_us\"],\n                t2=(self.cfg[\"t1_bad_us\"] * 0.7 if bad else self.cfg[\"t1_good_us\"] * 0.8),\n            )\n        return st\n\n    def step(self):\n        d = self.cfg[\"drift\"]\n        for q in range(self.M):\n            scale = 1.25 if q in self.bad else 1.0\n            f = 1.0 + d * scale * abs(self.rng.normal(0, 1)) * 0.1\n            self.live[q][\"ro\"] = min(0.35, self.live[q][\"ro\"] * f)\n            self.live[q][\"xerr\"] = min(0.15, self.live[q][\"xerr\"] * f)\n            self.live[q][\"t1\"] = max(5.0, self.live[q][\"t1\"] / f)\n            self.live[q][\"t2\"] = max(3.0, self.live[q][\"t2\"] / f)\n\n    def friction(self):\n        fr = np.zeros(self.M)\n        for q in range(self.M):\n            s = self.live[q]\n            # fricción alta = qubit malo\n            fr[q] = min(1.0,\n                0.35 * (s[\"ro\"] / 0.15) +\n                0.25 * (s[\"xerr\"] / 0.05) +\n                0.40 * (1.0 - min(1.0, s[\"t1\"] / 80.0)))\n        return fr\n\n    def noise_model(self):\n        nm = NoiseModel()\n        for q in range(self.M):\n            s = self.live[q]\n            ro = min(0.49, s[\"ro\"])\n            nm.add_readout_error(ReadoutError([[1 - ro, ro], [ro, 1 - ro]]), [q])\n            # thermal relaxation en delay / gates\n            t1, t2 = s[\"t1\"] * 1e-6, s[\"t2\"] * 1e-6  # a segundos\n            for gate, dur in ((\"sx\", 50e-9), (\"x\", 100e-9), (\"id\", 50e-9)):\n                try:\n                    err = thermal_relaxation_error(t1, t2, dur)\n                    nm.add_quantum_error(err, [gate], [q])\n                except Exception:\n                    nm.add_quantum_error(depolarizing_error(min(0.5, s[\"xerr\"] * 2), 1), [gate], [q])\n            # delay largo: decoherencia explícita\n            try:\n                err_d = thermal_relaxation_error(t1, t2, IDLE_US * 1e-6)\n                nm.add_quantum_error(err_d, [\"delay\"], [q])\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n            xe = min(0.5, s[\"xerr\"] * 2)\n            nm.add_quantum_error(depolarizing_error(xe, 1), [\"rz\"], [q])\n        for a in range(self.M - 1):\n            bad_edge = (a in self.bad) or ((a + 1) in self.bad)\n            p = self.cfg[\"cx_bad\"] if bad_edge else self.cfg[\"cx_good\"]\n            e = depolarizing_error(min(0.5, p), 2)\n            nm.add_quantum_error(e, [\"cx\"], [a, a + 1])\n            nm.add_quantum_error(e, [\"cx\"], [a + 1, a])\n        return nm\n\nbackend = sim_backend = device = None\nfr_live = None\nn_phys = None\n\nif MODE == \"cpu\":\n    device = HostileDevice(SIM)\n    for _ in range(2):\n        device.step()\n    fr_live = device.friction()\n    n_phys = device.M\n    cm = CouplingMap([[i, i + 1] for i in range(n_phys - 1)] +\n                     [[i + 1, i] for i in range(n_phys - 1)])\n    sim_backend = AerSimulator(\n        noise_model=device.noise_model(), coupling_map=cm,\n        basis_gates=[\"rz\", \"sx\", \"x\", \"cx\", \"measure\", \"delay\", \"id\", \"barrier\"])\n    MOTOR[\"ojos\"] = {\"active\": True, \"detail\": \"Hostile mean_fr=%.3f bad=%s\" % (\n        fr_live.mean(), sorted(device.bad))}\nelse:\n    from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService\n    service = QiskitRuntimeService()\n    backend = service.backend(BACKEND_NAME)\n    n_phys = backend.num_qubits\n    props = backend.properties()\n    fr_live = np.zeros(n_phys)\n    for q in range(n_phys):\n        try: ro = props.readout_error(q)\n        except Exception: ro = 0.02\n        try: xe = props.gate_error(\"x\", [q])\n        except Exception: xe = 0.001\n        try: t1 = props.t1(q) * 1e6\n        except Exception: t1 = 50.0\n        fr_live[q] = min(1.0, 0.35 * (ro / 0.05) + 0.25 * (xe / 0.01) + 0.4 * (1 - min(1, t1 / 80)))\n    MOTOR[\"ojos\"] = {\"active\": True, \"detail\": \"%s mean_fr=%.3f\" % (BACKEND_NAME, fr_live.mean())}\n\nprint(MOTOR[\"ojos\"][\"detail\"])\nprint(\"fricción por qubit:\", np.round(fr_live, 3).tolist())\n\nif MODE == \"cpu\":\n    edges = [[i, i + 1] for i in range(n_phys - 1)]\nelse:\n    edges = list(backend.coupling_map.get_edges())\nadj = defaultdict(list)\nfor a, b in edges:\n    adj[int(a)].append(int(b)); adj[int(b)].append(int(a))\n\ndef path_layouts(n_logical, blacklist, max_paths=80):\n    bl = set(int(x) for x in blacklist)\n    found = []\n    def dfs(path):\n        if len(found) >= max_paths: return\n        if len(path) == n_logical:\n            found.append(list(path)); return\n        last = path[-1]\n        cands = sorted(adj[last], key=lambda q: fr_live[q] if q < len(fr_live) else 1.0)\n        for nxt in cands:\n            if nxt in path or nxt in bl: continue\n            dfs(path + [nxt])\n    starts = sorted(range(n_phys), key=lambda q: fr_live[q] if q < len(fr_live) else 1.0)\n    for s in starts:\n        if s in bl: continue\n        dfs([s])\n        if len(found) >= max_paths: break\n    return found\n\ndef score(layout):\n    return float(np.mean([fr_live[q] if q < len(fr_live) else 1.0 for q in layout]))\n\nmean_fr = float(fr_live.mean())\nif mean_fr >= ABORT_FR_MEAN:\n    raise RuntimeError(\"Juicio ABORT mean_fr=%.3f\" % mean_fr)\nMOTOR[\"juicio\"] = {\"active\": True, \"detail\": \"continuar mean_fr=%.3f\" % mean_fr}\n\n# Reflejos: blacklist qubits malos; layout EQG en zona sana\nblacklist = [q for q in range(n_phys) if fr_live[q] >= DD_FRICTION_THR]\npaths = path_layouts(N, blacklist)\nif not paths:\n    paths = path_layouts(N, [])  # relajar\npaths = sorted(paths, key=score)\nLAYOUT_NONE = list(range(N))                    # ingenuo: 0..N-1 = zona MALA\nLAYOUT_EQG = paths[0] if paths else list(range(n_phys - N, n_phys))\n# garantizar que EQG ≠ baseline cuando hay qubits buenos\nif LAYOUT_EQG == LAYOUT_NONE:\n    for p in paths:\n        if p != LAYOUT_NONE:\n            LAYOUT_EQG = p; break\n    else:\n        # forzar extremo sano del chip\n        LAYOUT_EQG = list(range(n_phys - new.delay(half, qa[0], unit=unit)\n                new.x(qa[0]); new.delay(half, qa[0], unit=unit)\n                added += 2; continue\n        new.append(op, qa, ca)\n    return new, added\n\ndef _force_prefix(tc, qubits):\n    from qiskit import QuantumCircuit as QC\n    new = QC(tc.num_qubits, tc.num_clbits)\n    qi = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(tc.qubits)}\n    ci = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(tc.clbits)}\n    added = 0\n    for q in qubits:\n        q = int(q)\n        if 0 <= q < tc.num_qubits:\n            new.x(q); new.delay(max(IDLE_US / 4, 1.0), q, unit=\"us\")\n            new.x(q); new.delay(max(IDLE_US / 4, 1.0), q, unit=\"us\")\n            added += 2\n    for inst in tc.data:\n        new.append(inst.operation, [qi[q] for q in inst.qubits], [ci[c] for c in inst.clbits])\n    return new, added\n\ndef apply_dd(tc, tgt, qubits):\n    if not qubits:\n        return tc, 0\n    qs = [int(q) for q in qubits]\n    before = int(tc.count_ops().get(\"x\", 0))\n    target = getattr(tgt, \"target\", None)\n    if target is not None:\n        try:\n            pm = PassManager([\n                ALAPScheduleAnalysis(target=target),\n                PadDynamicalDecoupling(target=target, dd_sequence=[XGate(), XGate()],\n                    qubits=qs, pulse_alignment=getattr(target, \"pulse_alignment\", 1),\n                    skip_reset_qubits=False)])\n            tc2 = pm.run(tc)\n            a = int(tc2.count_ops().get(\"x\", 0)) - before\n            if a > 0: return tc2, a\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n    try:\n        durs = _durs(tc.num_qubits)\n        pm = PassManager([\n            ALAPScheduleAnalysis(instruction_durations=durs),\n            PadDynamicalDecoupling(durations=durs, dd_sequence=[XGate(), XGate()],\n                qubits=qs, pulse_alignment=1, skip_reset_qubits=False)])\n        tc2 = pm.run(tc)\n        a = int(tc2.count_ops().get(\"x\", 0)) - before\n        if a > 0: return tc2, a\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n    tc2, a = _manual_cpmg(tc, qs)\n    if a > 0: return tc2, a\n    return _force_prefix(tc, qs)\n\ndef basis_change(qc, basis):\n    if basis == \"X\":\n        for q in range(qc.num_qubits): qc.h(q)\n    elif basis == \"Y\":\n        for q in range(qc.num_qubits):\n            qc.sdg(q); qc.h(q)\n    qc.measure_all()\n    return qc\n\n_dd = defaultdict(int)\n_cache = {}\n\ndef build_prep(kind):\n    if kind == \"qaoa\":\n        return qaoa_prep(N, QAOA_P, GAMMAS, BETAS, with_idle=True)\n    return hea_prep(N, HEA_LAYERS, T5_P, with_idle=True)\n\ndef make_circuit(hname, arm, cycle, gidx):\n    d = HAM[hname]\n    layout = LAYOUT_NONE if arm == \"sin_eqg\" else LAYOUT_EQG\n    qc = build_prep(d[\"kind\"]).copy()\n    basis_change(qc, d[\"groups\"][gidx][\"basis\"])\n    tgt = sim_backend if MODE == \"cpu\" else backend\n    tc = transpile(qc, tgt, initial_layout=list(layout),\n                   optimization_level=1, seed_transpiler=SEED + cycle * 19 + gidx)\n    if arm == \"eqg\":\n        if cycle < PREFLIGHT:\n            qs = list(layout)\n        else:\n            qs = [q for q in layout if q < len(fr_live) and fr_live[q] >= DD_FRICTION_THR * 0.7]\n            if len(qs) < 2:\n                ranked = sorted(layout, key=lambda q: fr_live[q] if q < len(fr_live) else 0, reverse=True)\n                qs = ranked[: max(2, len(layout) // 2)]\n        tc, nadd = apply_dd(tc, tgt, qs)\n        _dd[arm] += nadd\n    return tc\n\ndef get_c(h, a, cyc, g):\n    k = (h, a, cyc, g)\n    if k not in _cache:\n        _cache[k] = make_circuit(h, a, cyc, g)\n    return _cache[k]\n\ndef est_cost(nc, shots, per=350e-6):\n    return nc * shots * per + 3.0 * max(1, nc // 40)\n\ndef execute(tcs, shots):\n    if MODE == \"cpu\":\n        out = []\n        for i in range(0, len(tcs), 20):\n            if device is not None and i > 0:\n                device.step()\n            part = tcs[i:i + 20]\n            res = sim_backend.run(part, shots=shots).result()\n            out += [res.get_counts(j) for j in range(len(part))]\n            gc.collect()\n        return out\n    from qiskit_ibm_runtime import SamplerV2\n    sampler = SamplerV2(mode=backend)\n    job = sampler.run([(tc, None, shots) for tc in tcs])\n    jid = job.job_id();
